column1: # config/data.tsv -- the image's bytes that are neither compiled code nor yet data from source, range by range.
# ./wof datamap checks it against the last gate and counts it; the header of tools/datamap.c defines the columns:
# start, end (exclusive), kind (ident fill rodata data ucode), owner (a unit; new:NAME, an object no unit holds
# yet; sdk:NAME, an SDK object linked whole; '-' for fill between objects; ?A..B or "?A B", one of those units),
# type (as datagen takes it; "strings" for a run of char arrays defined one by one; bin for bytes no C file
# holds; '-' for RCS runs and fill; '?' where the evidence gives none), evidence.
# The game's creative content (puzzles, credits, clip masks) is not mapped here: its units define it, the build takes
# its initialisers from the cartridge, and config/assets.tsv lists those ranges, which datamap counts as asset bytes.
